name: Chicken & Rice Bowl
description: Simple high-protein lunch prep. Microwave-friendly for work.
instructions:
1. Cook rice according to package directions (about 20 min).
2. Season chicken breast with salt and olive oil; pan-sear 6-7 min per side until internal temp reaches 74C.
3. Slice chicken; serve over rice. Add spinach on the side or wilt into the rice.

name: Oatmeal with Blueberries
description: Quick low-FODMAP breakfast ready in under 10 minutes.
instructions:
1. Combine oats and lactose-free milk in a bowl.
2. Microwave for 2-3 minutes, stirring halfway.
3. Top with fresh blueberries and serve.

name: Salmon & Potato Plate
description: Balanced low-FODMAP dinner rich in omega-3 and potassium.
instructions:
1. Boil potatoes for 15-20 minutes until fork-tender.
2. Season salmon with olive oil and salt; pan-sear skin-side down 4 min, flip and cook 3 more minutes.
3. Serve salmon alongside boiled potatoes with a side of steamed carrots.

name: Greek Yogurt Protein Bowl
instructions:
1. Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
2. Top with almonds and blueberries.
3. Serve immediately.

name: Chicken & Spinach Salad
description: Light high-protein lunch; no reheating needed.
instructions:
1. Pan-sear chicken breast with olive oil, 6-7 min per side. Let rest, then slice.
2. Toss raw spinach with olive oil and a squeeze of lemon (if tolerated).
3. Top spinach with sliced chicken, grated carrot, and almonds.

name: Spinach Omelette
description: Quick high-protein breakfast; low FODMAP and ready in 10 minutes.
instructions:
1. Whisk eggs with a pinch of salt.
2. Heat a non-stick pan with a little olive oil; pour in eggs.
3. When edges set, add spinach on one half; fold and cook 1 more minute.
4. Serve immediately.
